Generalization beyond the recruited units
requires a sampling or transport argument.
text:
\Cref{sec:p15-w02b-p15-075} separates the recruited units from the target
population, states the linking premises, and gives a conservative variance
estimator, a finite-sample interval and a randomization test for \(\tau\).
It also contrasts random sampling and random assignment with observational
comparisons.
